name: Low density residential zone
purpose: Provides for predominantly dwelling houses on individual lots in a low-rise, detached setting, with limited non-residential uses that serve local residents.
typical: Dwelling house, secondary dwelling, home-based business. Multiple dwellings and most non-residential uses are generally inconsistent.

name: Character residential zone
purpose: Protects and maintains areas of traditional (largely pre-1947) housing character, allowing infill that respects the established streetscape. Precincts: Character, Infill housing.
typical: Dwelling house and dual occupancy (in suitable precincts); demolition and new building design are tightly controlled through character codes.

name: Low-medium density residential zone
purpose: Provides for a mix of dwelling types at low-medium density, including dwelling houses, dual occupancies, row housing and low-rise multiple dwellings. Precincts: 2 storey mix, 2 or 3 storey mix, Up to 3 storeys.
typical: Dual occupancy, multiple dwellings (precinct dependent), dwelling house.

name: Medium density residential zone
purpose: Provides for medium density residential development, mainly multiple dwellings, generally close to centres, public transport and services.
typical: Multiple dwellings, rooming accommodation, retirement facility; small-scale ancillary non-residential uses.

name: High density residential zone
purpose: Provides for high density residential development in well-serviced locations. Precincts: Up to 8 storeys, Up to 15 storeys.
typical: Multiple dwellings, short-term accommodation, residential care; ground-level small-scale services.

name: Tourist accommodation zone
purpose: Provides for short-term and tourist accommodation and associated services.
typical: Short-term accommodation, multiple dwellings, associated food and drink outlets.

name: Principal centre zone
purpose: Brisbane's highest-order centres with the widest range and greatest intensity of uses. Precincts: City centre, Regional centre.
typical: Office, retail, entertainment, high density residential and mixed use.

name: Major centre zone
purpose: Large centres providing a broad mix of retail, commercial, community and residential uses for a wide catchment.
typical: Shopping centre, office, residential above ground level, community uses.

name: District centre zone
purpose: Centres serving a district with a range of retail, commercial, community and residential uses. Precincts: District, Corridor.
typical: Shop, office, food and drink outlet, health care, residential.

name: Neighbourhood centre zone
purpose: Small-scale centres meeting the daily convenience needs of the local community.
typical: Shop, food and drink outlet, office and health care at local scale, residential above.

name: Mixed use zone
purpose: Provides for a mix of commercial, retail, residential and community uses in a compatible arrangement. Precincts: Inner city, Centre frame, Corridor.
typical: Office, shop, multiple dwellings, food and drink outlet, health care.

name: Specialised centre zone
purpose: Centres with a specialised role (e.g. large format retail, markets, major education/research, entertainment, marina, mixed industry and business).
typical: Uses specific to the precinct's specialised role.

name: Low impact industry zone
purpose: Provides for low impact industrial and service industry uses that are compatible with nearby sensitive uses.
typical: Low impact industry, service industry, warehouse, research and technology industry.

name: Industry zone
purpose: Provides for medium and higher impact industrial uses, protected from incompatible sensitive uses. Precincts: General industry A, B, C.
typical: Medium impact industry, warehouse, transport depot; higher impact uses in precinct C.

name: Special industry zone
purpose: Provides for special and high impact industries requiring separation from sensitive uses.
typical: Special industry, high impact industry.

name: Industry investigation zone
purpose: Identifies land being investigated for future industrial use; interim uses must not compromise that future.
typical: Existing uses; new development is generally limited.

name: Emerging community zone
purpose: Identifies land intended for future urban development once planning and infrastructure are resolved; prevents premature or fragmenting development.
typical: Dwelling house on existing lots; reconfiguration and urban development need structure planning.

name: Rural residential zone
purpose: Provides for residential living on large lots in a semi-rural setting with limited services.
typical: Dwelling house, secondary dwelling, home-based business, animal keeping at low intensity.

name: Rural zone
purpose: Protects rural land for rural activities, landscape and environmental values.
typical: Cropping, animal husbandry, dwelling house, rural activities.

name: Sport and recreation zone
purpose: Provides for organised sport and recreation facilities and associated uses.
typical: Outdoor sport and recreation, club, park.

name: Open space zone
purpose: Provides for public parks and open space for informal recreation.
typical: Park, landscaping, minor ancillary facilities.

name: Environmental management zone
purpose: Protects land with environmental values while allowing limited low-impact use.
typical: Dwelling house on existing lots with environmental safeguards.

name: Conservation zone
purpose: Protects and manages land with significant ecological values. Precincts: Local, District, Metropolitan.
typical: Environment facility, park; development generally limited.

name: Community facilities zone
purpose: Provides for community-related uses. Precincts include Community purposes, Education purposes, Emergency services, Health care purposes, Major health care, Major sports venue, Cemetery.
typical: Uses matching the precinct (e.g. school, hospital, community use).

name: Special purpose zone
purpose: Provides for public infrastructure and special purposes. Precincts include Airport, Defence, Detention facility, Transport infrastructure, Utility services.
typical: Infrastructure and uses matching the precinct.

name: Priority Development Area (PDA)
purpose: The land is in a Priority Development Area declared under the Economic Development Act 2012. The PDA development scheme, not Brisbane City Plan 2014, regulates development, and Economic Development Queensland (EDQ) is usually the assessment manager. The underlying City Plan zone is for reference only.
typical: Uses and assessment set by the relevant PDA development scheme. Check EDQ's scheme and land-use plan for the precinct.

name: Extractive industry zone
purpose: Provides for extractive industry (quarrying) and protects resources from incompatible development.
typical: Extractive industry and associated uses.
